_note: Cards for 'Your first week with Femp AI' on femp.ai/jobs. aiGenerated: true shows an 'AI-generated example' badge (missing counts as true). Set false only for real early-access users who gave permission to quote them.

examples.name: Jasmine R.
examples.quote: Sent Femp AI one WhatsApp on Monday. Tuesday at 8:30 there were six AE roles waiting, each with a reason it fit me. By Friday I'd applied to eleven and had three recruiters asking for a call. Never opened a job board.

examples.name: Tyler M.
examples.quote: All I gave it was my LinkedIn, an old resume and a rambling two-minute voice note. Back came a resume that sounded like me, just sharper. First interview that Thursday, signed nine days later, and it's $7k more than my last base.

examples.name: Parker S.
examples.quote: Said yes to three roles from the train. Femp AI filled in every form and even checked with me before answering a screening question it wasn't sure about. Two of the three emailed me back before the weekend.

examples.name: Marcus J.
examples.quote: I genuinely hate writing cover letters. Femp AI wrote one for every job it picked for me. I read them on my lunch break, replied yes, and all five went out. Got a first-round interview off one of them the very next week.

examples.name: Emily C.
examples.quote: Femp AI found a staff accountant role I loved and told me my resume scored 58 for it. Ouch. It rewrote it to 91 and applied when I said yes. Interview on day three, offer two weeks later. I still haven't searched for a job myself.

examples.name: David K.
examples.quote: Nine tailored applications my first week. One went quiet, so Femp AI found the hiring manager and drafted a short follow-up. I said yes. That's the company that called me back, and I'm in their final round now.

examples.name: Sofia G.
examples.quote: Femp AI kept suggesting roles I'd never have searched for. It reworked my resume around my launch results for each one, and I just kept saying yes. One of those 'never would've found it' roles is where I start next month, paying 18% more.

examples.name: Ryan O.
examples.quote: I named five dream companies, half joking. Two days later Femp AI pinged me that one had just posted a role, before I saw it anywhere else. My application was in before lunch, and the recruiter screen was booked by Friday.

examples.name: Aaliyah W.
examples.quote: Nursing to pharma sales felt impossible. Femp AI turned my patient stories into a real sales resume, found the roles and applied for me. Offer in week two. First time in years I'm earning more without picking up extra shifts.

examples.name: Kevin L.
examples.quote: Femp AI did the searching, the applying and the follow-ups. Best part? It spotted an interview request sitting in my Gmail promotions tab that I'd totally missed. I'd have lost that one. Interview's on Tuesday.

examples.name: Hannah B.
examples.quote: Coffee, then whatever territory roles Femp AI picked overnight, pay and travel spelled out. Tap yes, done. The weekly scorecard showed one resume version getting way more replies, so we switched to it. Two interviews the next week.
